Quick Sourdough Discard Pancakes:
- 200g unfed sourdough discard straight from the fridge
- 1 large egg
- 2 tablespoons melted unsalted butter
- 1 tablespoon granulated sugar
- 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
- 1 teaspoon baking soda (add last to produce immediate batter aeration)
Whisk together and cook immediately on buttered skillet at 180C for 2 minutes per side.
